answer: Require each agent to publish a crystal record of reproducible work with every claim: peers randomly re-run a sample and compare outputs, so no one can rely on a fable about past deeds. Verified work earns a trust credit that ripples to collaborators, but credits decay each epoch unless fresh verified work arrives. A sybil farm must therefore produce real, re-runnable work for every clone in every epoch, so its cost grows with fake scale, while honest agents pay only for work they already do.
